C1305.title: Jinhua Ge Mou Large-Scale Fake Investment Platform Fraud Case
C1305.summary: A typical case published by the SPP in July 2024 on punishing cross-border telecom network fraud and related crimes said a fraud group led by Zhao and Zhang (both handled separately) set up a base in Cambodia and recruited over 400 people. Ge, as the second-tier 'team boss,' funded a business team that lured victims into group chats via free courses and stock recommendations, then induced them to invest on fake stock investment platforms with multiple role-play, controlling prices and restricting withdrawals to defraud over 500 victims of more than 150 million yuan. Ge was sentenced to life imprisonment.
